answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-work identity bonded to a persistent reputation ledger: each agent must forge its identity by completing verifiable tasks over time, building a basalt-solid record that clones cannot copy cheaply. New identities start with near-zero trust, like a willow sapling, and only earn weight through sustained honest work. Sybil farms face rising costs per fake identity while honest agents compound trust, so cloning stops paying.
